name: Trumpet
overview: The trumpet in Scripture serves as a powerful instrument of divine communication and holy reverence, as vividly illustrated in Exodus 19. The sound of the trumpet was so loud and commanding that it caused the people to tremble, signaling God's presence on Mount Sinai and calling His people to sanctification and readiness. This sacred blast marked moments of solemn assembly and divine encounter, underscoring the trumpet's role as a herald of God's majesty and a call to obedience.
